corrections.why: The list uses BLL-nnn for coordinates the Georgia Forestry Commission provided, and gfc-nnn for numbers from an older Forestry Commission list. The row shows source codes, not lookout register entries. Please check before applying.

notes_for_editor: Two sources, both lists: tnlandforms gives coordinates, county and codes; the Eastern index names a Davis tower in Charlton County with no detail. No history, status or access found. The row has an unexplained word 'gowen' between its codes; not used. Elevation 141 has no unit label in the table; left out. A Charlton County agenda found by search mentions a Georgia Forestry Commission tower on Dawsie Crews Road under a lease; I could not read that page and have not linked it to this record. No separate Eastern US Lookouts page exists for this Davis tower (the index entry has no link).
